name: metrics / metrics_with / cyclomatic_complexity

test_list.description: Identical inputs give churn 0, cyclomatic delta 0, tree-edit distance 0 and no changed symbols.
Adding one if raises cyclomatic by 1 (and removing it lowers by 1) in all five languages.
Churn is lines added plus lines deleted, in both directions.
A CRLF/LF change counts as changed lines (byte-faithful, EOLs are never normalised).
Renaming an identifier costs 1; inserting a statement costs its node count.
Comments and layout do not move the tree-edit distance but do count as churn.
Above the node cap the distance is a flagged lower bound; the other metrics are unaffected.
Edited, added and removed declarations (including methods) are listed in a stable order; unchanged ones are not.
Spacing and comments between declarations change nothing.
20k-deep nesting is measured via the capped, iterative path.
Property: metrics(x, x) is all zeros.
Property: churn and tree-edit distance are symmetric, cyclomatic delta is antisymmetric.
Property: the capped fallback never exceeds the exact distance.

output_description: churn_lines, cyclomatic_delta, tree_edit_distance (+exact flag) and changed symbols.
